# Kilerce (3.2.2+16)
> Kilerce: Barkod, Dolap & Tarif — Akıllı Mutfak Envanteri, Fiş OCR, Helal/E-Kodu Gıda Analizi ve 7 Bölgeden 100 Türk Ev Yemeği Asistanı.

## What is Kilerce?
Kilerce is a cross-platform mobile kitchen assistant developed by Akarworks (Android `com.akarworks.organicscore`, iOS `com.akarworks.kilerce`, version 3.2.2+16) for Fridge, Pantry, and Freezer inventory management, clean-label food scanning, and zero-waste home cooking. Using on-device barcode scanning, paper receipt OCR, and 6 unbarcoded market intake channels (butcher, produce, fishmonger, spice shop, homemade, and natural-text batch entry), Kilerce tracks ingredient freshness locally inside SQLite without uploading camera images to developer servers. Kilerce matches available pantry items against 100 authentic Turkish home recipes spanning 7 geographical regions, prioritizes waste-rescue dishes for expiring or long-waiting food, and evaluates 35+ E-number food additives for Halal status, allergens, and official adulteration records. Supported in Turkish (`tr-TR`) and English (`en-US`), Kilerce works offline in grocery aisles and offers optional private Google Drive AppData backup at https://akarworks.com/kilerce.

## Key Pages & Portals
- [Official Download & Smart Store Redirect](https://akarworks.com/kilerce/indir.html): Automatic iOS App Store, Google Play Store, and release APK portal.
- [Privacy Policy & KVKK/GDPR Compliance](https://akarworks.com/kilerce/index.html): On-device processing, zero developer server tracking, and local SQLite disclosure.
- [User Support & FAQ](https://akarworks.com/kilerce/support.html): Troubleshooting, contact channels (`akarbilisimteknolojileri@gmail.com`), and release history.
- [Extended AI Knowledge Base](https://akarworks.com/kilerce/llms-full.txt): Complete technical architecture, ASO capabilities, and structured FAQ.

## Core Capabilities
- Smart Pantry Inventory: Track Fridge, Pantry, and Freezer zones with barcode scan, receipt OCR, and 6 unbarcoded market channels.
- 100 Regional Turkish Recipes: Curated catalog across 7 Turkish regions with live portion scaling, calories, waste-rescue matching, and Smart Shopping List sync.
- Clean-Label & Halal Food Scanner: Evaluate 35+ E-numbers (E120, E441, E471, etc.), allergens, gluten/lactose/palm oil, and official adulteration announcements offline.
